This PR is part of a stack (oldest at bottom):

* #48026
* #48025
* #48024
* #48023
* #48022

* #48008
* #48007
* #48006
* #48005
* #48004
* #48003
* #48002
* #48001

## Motivation

Under `--enable-unified-memory` a pool may hold several window sub-pools (the target's window and draft windows of other lengths). PD transfers registered one state entry per window, but peers found an entry's pages by its state type: the second window had a state type of its own (`auxiliary_swa`) only so that its entry could find its sub-pool, and a third window had none, so such a plan could not list its PD entries. Peers also paired entries by position without checking that both sides registered the same entries.

## Modifications

- `disaggregation/utils.py`, `base/conn.py`, `mem_cache/kv/plan.py`: each registered state entry records the sub-pool it carries (`KVArgs.state_sub_pools`, parallel to `state_types`; `None` for a static pool, whose entries are slices of its pools). Prefill and decode build one payload per entry (`state_indices_per_entry`); a window entry carries its own sub-pool's pages. A transfer's rows are recorded against the entry's sub-pool by position.
- Every window travels as the window state type (`swa`) and is told apart by its sub-pool; the plan lists window entries by sub-pool name, so peers order them alike whatever order a model declares them in. `StateType.AUXILIARY_SWA` and its uses in the Mooncake and NIXL engines are removed.
- `disaggregation/common/conn.py`, `decode.py`, `prefill.py`: the prefill reports its entries to the bootstrap server as (state type, sub-pool) pairs, kept per pipeline stage; a decode whose entries differ refuses to connect and names both lists (`check_state_wire`). Ranks of one stage that register different entries are refused. An older peer that reports no entries is not checked.
- Tests: `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_unified_window_wire.py` (two and three windows each register and carry their own entry; mismatched peers are refused; per-stage entries through the bootstrap handlers), plus updates to `test_unified_window_sub_pools.py` and existing PD tests.

**Behavior change:** a PD decode whose state entries differ from its prefill's (same pool kind, different window sub-pools or order) now fails at bootstrap with both entry lists, instead of transferring into mismatched rows. Static pools register no sub-pools and keep their pairing.

## Accuracy Tests

Serving validation was run at the **top of this 26-PR stack** (the cumulative change), not at this PR's head. Software: torch 2.14.1+cu130, flashinfer 0.7.2, sglang-kernel 0.4.10. GSM8K is few-shot, 500 or 1319 questions as noted; `main` is the same commit the stack is based on, same flags.

| Hardware | Model | Configuration | Stack top | main |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, `--enable-unified-memory` (rebased stack) | 0.954 (1319 q) | 0.950–0.954 |
| 1x H200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b | TP1, `--enable-unified-memory --max-total-tokens 120000` (rebased stack) | 0.842 (1319 q) | 0.839 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified, MTP (EAGLE, 3 steps, topk 1, 4 draft tokens) | 0.951, accept length 3.56 | 0.953, 3.56 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified, DFlash draft | 0.951, accept length 5.42 | 0.952, 5.44 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | PD (prefill TP1 + decode TP1, mooncake), unified, repeated runs | 0.952–0.960, no hang | 0.954–0.958 |
| 2x H200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b | PD (TP1 + TP1, mooncake), unified | 0.810 | 0.808 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified, HiCache | 0.954 | — |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | PP2, unified | 0.953 | 0.955 (static pools) |
| 2x B200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified (500 q) | 0.958 | 0.960 |
| 2x B200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b | TP2, unified, `trtllm_mha` (1319 q) | 0.849 | 0.863 |
| 2x B300 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B / openai/gpt-oss-120b | TP2, unified | 0.950 / 0.849 | 0.954 / 0.849 |

On B200 and B300, 40 greedy GSM8K generations were compared with `main`: 35–40 of 40 are identical, and the rest first differ after at least 27 characters (near ties). The H200 runs above other than the two marked "rebased stack" were run at the stack top before it was rebased onto the current base; the code they cover is unchanged by the rebase except for conflict resolutions.

The PD rows (Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B and openai/gpt-oss-120b, mooncake) exercise the state-entry registration and the bootstrap comparison here, each with a single window entry; several-window PD entries are covered by the unit tests above.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No performance-sensitive path changes; entries are built once per transfer. Measured at the stack top, same flags as `main` (bench_serving, random 4096-in / 512-out unless noted):

| Hardware | Model / configuration | Stack top | main |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1x H200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b, unified, `--max-total-tokens 120000` | 3.93–3.95 req/s | 3.95 req/s |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B PD (TP1 + TP1), 2048-in / 256-out | 5.65–6.28 req/s | 6.21–6.29 req/s |
| 2x H200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b PD (TP1 + TP1) | 9.39–9.45 req/s | 9.21 req/s |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B MTP TP2 / DFlash TP2 | 4.26 / 4.36 req/s | 4.29 / 4.35 req/s |
| 2x B200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B TP2 / openai/gpt-oss-120b TP2 | 6.35 / 19.31 req/s | 6.34 / 19.28 req/s |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

     MAMBA = "mamba"

+    # A window sub-pool's trailing pages; a unified pool registers one entry

     DSA = "dsa"

     aux_data_lens: List[int]
     aux_item_lens: List[int]
     state_types: List[StateType]
+    # The sub-pool each state entry carries, parallel to state_types: entries
+    # of one state type (every window travels as SWA) are told apart by it.
+    state_sub_pools: List[Optional[str]]
     state_data_ptrs: List[List[int]]
     state_data_lens: List[List[int]]
     state_item_lens: List[List[int]]

@@ -46,9 +46,11 @@

     MetadataBuffers,

 )

+    # The state entries every prefill rank registers, as (state type, sub-pool)
+    # pairs; None when pipeline stages register different ones (stages that
+    # hold different sub-pools) or the ranks do not report them.
+    state_wire: Optional[List[List[Optional[str]]]] = None
+    # Each pipeline stage's entries, by stage, when the stages differ.
+    state_wires: Optional[List[Optional[List[List[Optional[str]]]]]] = None
     decode_allocation_policy: str = "early"
     # Each prefill shard-group rank owns a subset of logical KV pages.
     enable_kv_cache_sharding: bool = False
@@ -1361,6 +1369,22 @@ def _run_prefill_recompute(
                 f"PD retract rebootstrap /generate request errored for rid={rid}.",
             )
 
+    def _check_prefill_state_entries(self, info: PrefillServerInfo) -> None:
+        """Refuse a prefill server whose state entries cannot pair with this
+        server's: compared per pipeline stage when its stages differ."""
+        prefill_wire = info.state_wire
+        if prefill_wire is None and info.state_wires:
+            if info.pp_size == self.pp_size and self.pp_rank < len(info.state_wires):
+                prefill_wire = info.state_wires[self.pp_rank]
+            else:
+                logger.warning(
+                    "PD state entries are not compared: the prefill server's "
+                    "pipeline stages register different state entries and its "
+                    f"stage count ({info.pp_size}) differs from this server's "
+                    f"({self.pp_size})."
+                )
+        check_state_wire(prefill_wire, state_wire(self.kv_args))
+
     def try_ensure_parallel_info(self, bootstrap_addr: str) -> bool:
         """Single non-blocking attempt to fetch and cache prefill parallel info.
         Returns True if info is available (cached or freshly fetched)."""
@@ -1427,6 +1451,8 @@ def try_ensure_parallel_info(self, bootstrap_addr: str) -> bool:
                 f"must use the same --dsv4-attn-backend and SGLANG_DSV4_KV_LAYOUT."
             )
 
+        self._check_prefill_state_entries(info)
+
         local_layout = self.dsv41_spec_layout
         if local_layout is not None or info.dsv41_spec_layout is not None:
             if local_layout != info.dsv41_spec_layout:
@@ -1669,6 +1695,7 @@ def register_to_bootstrap(self):
             "kv_cache_dtype": self.kv_cache_dtype_str,
             "kv_layout": self.kv_layout,
             "dsv41_spec_layout": self.dsv41_spec_layout,
+            "state_wire": state_wire(self.kv_args),
             "load_balance_method": get_parallel().load_balance_method,
             "enable_dsa_cache_layer_split": get_parallel().enable_dsa_cache_layer_split,
             "enable_kv_cache_sharding": get_parallel().enable_kv_cache_sharding,
@@ -3108,6 +3135,7 @@ def __init__(self, host: str, port: int):
         self.kv_cache_dtype: Optional[str] = None
         self.kv_layout: Optional[str] = None
         self.dsv41_spec_layout: Optional[dict] = None
+        self.state_wire_by_stage: Dict[int, Optional[list]] = {}
         self.follow_bootstrap_room: Optional[bool] = None
         self.enable_dsa_cache_layer_split: Optional[bool] = None
         self.enable_kv_cache_sharding: Optional[bool] = None
@@ -3166,6 +3194,22 @@ async def _handle_route(self, request: web.Request):
                 text="Method not allowed", status=405, content_type="application/json"

+    def _state_wire(self) -> Optional[list]:
+        """The state entries every pipeline stage registers alike, if so."""
+        wires = list(self.state_wire_by_stage.values())
+        if wires and all(w == wires[0] for w in wires):
+            return wires[0]

+    def _state_wires(self) -> Optional[list]:
+        """Each stage's state entries, by stage, when the stages differ."""
+        if not self.state_wire_by_stage or self._state_wire() is not None:
+            return None
+        return [
+            self.state_wire_by_stage.get(stage)
+            for stage in range(max(self.state_wire_by_stage) + 1)
+        ]
+
     async def _handle_route_put(self, request: web.Request):
         data = await request.json()
         attn_tp_size = data["attn_tp_size"]

+            and self.state_wire_by_stage[pp_rank] != rank_state_wire
+        ):
+            return web.Response(
+                text="PD state entries differ across the ranks of one pipeline stage",
+                status=400,

                 kv_cache_dtype=self.kv_cache_dtype,

@@ -3318,6 +3374,10 @@ async def _handle_route_get(self, request: web.Request):

+            if info.state_wires is None:
+                payload.pop("state_wires")
             return web.json_response(payload, status=200)
 
         if not self._is_ready():

@@ -90,7 +90,7 @@

+"""PD peers carry each window sub-pool of a unified pool as an entry of its own.
+
+A unified pool may hold several windows. Each window's pages travel as their
+own state entry, registered with the window's sub-pool; the prefill sends and
+the decode receives that sub-pool's pages for it, and a transfer's rows are
+recorded against it. Two peers pair entries by position, so peers whose
+entries differ are refused before any transfer.
+"""
+
+import asyncio
+import json
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.base.conn import KVArgs, StateType
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.conn import (
+    CommonKVBootstrapServer,
+    CommonKVManager,
+    PrefillServerInfo,
+)
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import (
+    check_state_wire,
+    record_network_transfer,
+    setup_state_kv_args,
+    state_indices_per_entry,
+    state_wire,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv.build import UnifiedBuildContext, build_kv_storage
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv.decl import MHAGeometry, WindowLayers, kv_layer_decls
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv.plan import plan_kv_storage
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv.router import KV_PART
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv.sizing import KVSizingInputs, size_plan
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+from sglang.test.unified_allocator_fixtures import setup_allocator_context
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_MHA = MHAGeometry(head_num=1, head_dim=8, v_head_dim=8, kv_cache_dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+_WINDOWS = (16, 8, 4)
+
+
+def _storage(windows):
+    setup_allocator_context()
+    decls = kv_layer_decls(
+        full_layer_ids=(0,),
+        full_geometry=_MHA,
+        windows=[
+            WindowLayers(layer_ids=(i + 1,), geometry=_MHA, window=w)
+            for i, w in enumerate(windows)
+        ],
+    )
+    plan = plan_kv_storage(decls, page_size=4)
+    sized = size_plan(
+        plan,
+        KVSizingInputs(
+            full_tokens=128,
+            window_tokens=64,
+            state_slots=0,
+            max_running_requests=3,
+            context_len=64,
+            alignment=1,
+        ),
+    )
+    ctx = UnifiedBuildContext(
+        device="cpu",
+        start_layer=0,
+        end_layer=len(windows) + 1,
+        enable_memory_saver=False,
+        need_sort=False,
+        max_num_reqs=3,
+        model_context_len=64,
+        lazy_compaction=True,
+    )
+    return build_kv_storage(plan, sized, ctx)
+
+
+def _registered(windows):
+    storage = _storage(windows)
+    kv_args = KVArgs()
+    setup_state_kv_args(kv_args, storage)
+    return storage, kv_args
+
+
+def _window_names(windows):
+    return {f"window_{w}" for w in windows}
+

+class TestUnifiedWindowWire(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_each_window_registers_an_entry_of_its_own(self):
+        storage, kv_args = _registered(_WINDOWS)
+        self.assertEqual(kv_args.state_types, [StateType.SWA] * len(_WINDOWS))
+        self.assertEqual(set(kv_args.state_sub_pools), _window_names(_WINDOWS))
+        self.assertEqual(
+            kv_args.state_sub_pools, [e.sub_pool for e in storage.wire_entries()]
+        )
+        for sub_pool, ptrs, item_lens in zip(
+            kv_args.state_sub_pools, kv_args.state_data_ptrs, kv_args.state_item_lens

+            self.assertEqual(item_lens, list(region.item_lens))

+        self.assertEqual(recorded.kwargs["peer"], "peer")
+        self.assertTrue(recorded.kwargs["writes"])
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [(sub_pool, part.tolist()) for sub_pool, part in recorded.kwargs["states"]],
+            [
+                (sub_pool, part.tolist())
+                for sub_pool, part in zip(kv_args.state_sub_pools, ids)
+            ],
+        )
+
+    def test_peers_with_other_entries_are_refused(self):
+        _, prefill = _registered(_WINDOWS)
+        # Peers list the same entries whatever order the model declares its
+        # windows in.
+        _, decode = _registered(_WINDOWS[::-1])
+        self.assertEqual(state_wire(prefill), state_wire(decode))
+        check_state_wire(state_wire(prefill), state_wire(decode))
+        # A peer that does not report its entries is not checked.
+        check_state_wire(None, state_wire(decode))
+        _, one_window = _registered(_WINDOWS[:1])
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "PD state entry mismatch"):
+            check_state_wire(state_wire(prefill), state_wire(one_window))

+def _wire(sub_pools):

+class _Request:

+                    "pp_rank": pp_rank,
+                    "system_dp_size": 1,

+                    "rank_port": 1000 + pp_rank * tp_size + tp_rank,
+                    "page_size": 4,
+                    "kv_cache_dtype": "auto",

+def _served_info(server):
